default_root: <repository>/corpus, derived from package location rather than the current directory
label_source: The first relative directory beneath the selected corpus root is the ground-truth primary label.
artifact_family_source: The optional second relative directory is artifact-family metadata; deeper directories do not change either annotation.
inference_rule: Folder labels are corpus annotations only. They must not become automatic classifications for arbitrary scan targets.
retention: in-memory only; later manifests and reports are separately versioned
